notable_accolades: 16 Nobel laureates affiliated with Duke; 17 NCAA National Championships (Basketball, Golf, Lacrosse, Soccer, Tennis)
fields: and hundreds of graduate and professional programs.
max_age: No maximum age limit; Duke does not discriminate on the basis of age
deadline: Early Decision Deadline: Nov 2; Regular Decision Deadline: Jan 4; Transfer Application Deadline: Mar 15
application process: First-year applicants may apply via Common Application or QuestBridge Application; Transfer applicants may apply via Duke Transfer Application or Coalition (powered by Scoir); After submission, applicant receives email to access Application Checklist
financial_aid_policy: Full tuition grants for admitted undergraduates from North and South Carolina with family incomes of $150,000 or less; 100% of demonstrated financial need met by Duke
